ears_text: WHEN a production tag is created, the version control system shall create it as an annotated tag named v<major>.<minor>.<patch>.
test_script:
import re
import subprocess

import pytest

PROJECT = "/project"

PRODUCTION_RE = re.compile(r"^v(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$")
# Pre-release tags (release candidates, etc.) are not production tags.
PRERELEASE_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)(^|[-_.+])(rc|alpha|beta|pre|preview|dev|snapshot)[-_.]?\d*")


def _git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-c", f"safe.directory={PROJECT}", "-C", PROJECT, *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )


def _tags():
    res = _git("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:strip=2) %(objecttype)", "refs/tags")
    assert res.returncode == 0, f"git for-each-ref failed: {res.stderr}"
    tags = []
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        name, objtype = line.rsplit(" ", 1)
        tags.append((name, objtype))
    return tags


def _semver_key(name):
    match = PRODUCTION_RE.match(name)
    return tuple(int(x) for x in match.groups())


def test_newest_production_tag_is_an_annotated_semver_tag():
    """Only the newest production tag is judged, so one old mistake in a
    project's tag history never fails this forever."""
    inside = _git("rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree")
    bare = _git("rev-parse", "--is-bare-repository")
    assert inside.returncode == 0 or bare.returncode == 0, (
        f"{PROJECT} is not a git repository: {inside.stderr}"
    )

    tags = _tags()
    production = [(n, t) for n, t in tags if not PRERELEASE_RE.search(n) and PRODUCTION_RE.match(n)]
    malformed = [n for n, t in tags if not PRERELEASE_RE.search(n) and not PRODUCTION_RE.match(n)]

    if not production:
        if malformed:
            pytest.fail(f"no well-formed production tag exists; malformed candidates: {malformed}")
        pytest.skip("no production tags exist yet")

    name, objtype = max(production, key=lambda nt: _semver_key(nt[0]))
    assert objtype == "tag", f"{name!r}: is a lightweight tag (object type {objtype!r}), not annotated"
notes: Narrowed 2026-09-22 to judge only the newest well-formed production tag (by semver), matching this project's own 'a past mistake never fails forever' rule; a malformed tag among otherwise-fine ones is still flagged.
